quantile_convention: Sort ascending; position p*(n-1); linearly interpolate adjacent values (Hyndman-Fan type 7 / NumPy default), then round to 10 decimal places.
rank_rule: ascending SHA-256 bytes of WP005_MATCHED_RANDOM_GATE_V1:<seed>:<timestamp>; take exactly K
rank_timestamp_encoding: base-10 integer UTC microseconds since Unix epoch, no sign or leading zeros
seed_derivation: unsigned big-endian integer from first 8 bytes of SHA-256(WP005_MATCHED_RANDOM_GATE_SEED:<index>)
